newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq shares soar as tech stocks sizzle.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq shares soar as tech stocks sizzle.

text.p: Nasdaq shares soared on Tuesday, rallying almost two percent as the technology sector staged a mighty rally and investors took heart from a Federal Reserve decision to let rates stand.
The Nasdaq composite soared around 31 points to finish unofficially at 1601. Short-covering, bargain hunters and renewed institutional interest helped to drive its technology stocks up, traders said.
"The techs drove Nasdaq," said Tony Cecin, director of equity trading at Piper Jaffray. "When money piles into the market, that's where it goes."
Large-capitization technology stocks lead the pack, with chipmaker Intel Corp surging 3-11/32 to 97-29/32 and Microsoft Corp adding 4-15/16 to close at 138-13/16.
"People got bearish last week and put shorts out. When things don't go their way, they have to scramble," the trader said.
Bay Networks Inc whetted appetites for technology stocks after it said it was seeing strong sales across its product lines and a solid pricing environment.
Shares of Dell Computer Corp rose before it reported second quarter earnings of $0.59 per share compared to $0.28 per share in the prior year's quarter.
